data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 7.2m (2018: GBP 68.9m) is an improvement of GBP 1.0m (2018: deterioration of GBP 3.3m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to favourable developments on Property, Aviation and Marine classes with partially offsetting unfavourable developments across the other classes.
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 were GBP 321.993m. The syndicate reports a prior-year improvement (release) of GBP 1.0m (net of reinsurance) driven principally by favourable developments in Property, Aviation and Marine (and favourable development in Professional Indemnity / Property Binders), partially offset by unfavourable movements in other classes. A gross prior-year movement is not explicitly stated in the notes, therefore the reported net movement has been used as a fallback.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 7.2m (2018: GBP 68.9m) is an improvement of GBP 1.0m (2018: deterioration of GBP 3.3m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to favourable developments on Property, Aviation and Marine classes with partially offsetting unfavourable developments across the other classes.
Actual vs expected claims development was favourable in the period driven by the Professional Indemnity and Property Binders classes.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Liabilities) - explicit. A gross prior-year movement (gross change in prior years' claims provisions) is not presented in the notes; only a net prior-year improvement of GBP 1.0m is stated (Note 9). Per extraction rules, the net figure is used as a last-resort fallback and flagged. The balance sheet and technical reserves are impacted by RITC adjustments (2016 & Prior RITC noted), which distort comparatives; adjusted opening positions are shown in the notes. The claims development table is limited (2017 YoA) and RITC entries may make triangle-based PYD calculations unreliable.
